examples.en: He hacked a path through the tall grass with a large knife.
examples.zh: 他用一把大刀在高高的草叢中砍出一條路。

examples.en: Someone tried to hack into the school's website last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚有人試圖駭入學校的網站。

examples.en: Hikers hacked away the branches that blocked the trail.
examples.zh: 登山客砍掉了擋住步道的樹枝。

examples.en: The company lost data in a serious hack last year.
examples.zh: 這家公司去年在一次嚴重的駭客攻擊中遺失了資料。

examples.en: Here is a simple hack for keeping your desk tidy.
examples.zh: 這裡有個讓書桌保持整齊的簡單小技巧。

examples.en: Experts say the hack was caused by a weak password.
examples.zh: 專家說這次入侵是由強度不足的密碼造成的。

examples.en: She changed her hairstyle before the school photo.
examples.zh: 她在拍學校照片前換了髮型。

examples.en: This hairstyle is easy to take care of in summer.
examples.zh: 這種髮型在夏天很好整理。

examples.en: My brother's new hairstyle makes him look older.
examples.zh: 我哥哥的新髮型讓他看起來比較成熟。

examples.en: The coach talked to the players at half-time.
examples.zh: 教練在中場休息時跟球員談話。

examples.en: We bought drinks and snacks during half-time.
examples.zh: 我們在中場休息時買了飲料和點心。

examples.en: The score was tied at half-time.
examples.zh: 半場結束時比數是平手。

senses.zh: 中場休息時的；工時為全職一半的

examples.en: She has a half-time job at the library.
examples.zh: 她在圖書館有一份工時為全職一半的工作。

examples.en: The clinic offers half-time positions for nurses.
examples.zh: 這間診所提供護理師工時為全職一半的職缺。

examples.en: The crowd enjoyed the half-time show during the football match.
examples.zh: 觀眾欣賞了足球賽中場休息時的表演。

examples.en: Please halve the recipe if you are cooking for two.
examples.zh: 如果只有兩個人吃，請把食譜的份量減半。

examples.en: The store plans to halve its prices this weekend.
examples.zh: 這家店計畫在這個週末把價格砍半。

examples.en: Halve the apple and share it with your sister.
examples.zh: 把蘋果切成兩半，和你妹妹分著吃。

examples.en: Every new student receives a handbook on the first day.
examples.zh: 每位新生在第一天都會拿到一本手冊。

examples.en: The employee handbook explains the rules for taking leave.
examples.zh: 員工手冊說明了請假的規定。

examples.en: I found the answer in the safety handbook.
examples.zh: 我在安全手冊裡找到了答案。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a handout about the history test.
examples.zh: 老師發給我們一份有關歷史考試的講義。

examples.en: The charity gives handouts of food to families in need.
examples.zh: 這個慈善機構發放食物救濟品給有需要的家庭。

examples.en: Volunteers gave handouts to people walking past the station.
examples.zh: 志工把傳單發給走過車站的人。

examples.en: The school has strict rules against harassment.
examples.zh: 學校對騷擾行為訂有嚴格的規定。

examples.en: She reported the harassment to her manager.
examples.zh: 她向主管通報了這起騷擾事件。

examples.en: Online harassment can hurt young people deeply.
examples.zh: 網路騷擾可能深深傷害年輕人。

examples.en: The mayor took a hardline position on illegal parking.
examples.zh: 市長對違規停車採取強硬立場。

examples.en: The company has a hardline policy on being late.
examples.zh: 公司對遲到採取嚴格不通融的政策。

examples.en: Parents disagreed with the hardline approach of the school.
examples.zh: 家長不同意學校的強硬做法。

examples.en: The hardliner refused to discuss any change to the plan.
examples.zh: 那位強硬派人士拒絕討論計畫的任何更動。

examples.en: Some hardliners in the committee voted against the deal.
examples.zh: 委員會裡有些強硬派人士投票反對這項協議。

examples.en: A hardliner may find it difficult to work with others.
examples.zh: 強硬派人士可能很難與他人合作。

examples.en: This table is made of solid hardwood.
examples.zh: 這張桌子是用實心硬木做的。

examples.en: Hardwood floors are easy to clean but can be expensive.
examples.zh: 硬木地板很好清理，但價格可能偏高。

examples.en: Oak and maple are both common types of hardwood.
examples.zh: 橡木和楓木都是常見的硬木。

examples.en: These hardy plants can survive the cold winter.
examples.zh: 這些耐寒的植物能撐過寒冬。

examples.en: The hardy hikers walked ten kilometers in the rain.
examples.zh: 那些強健的登山客在雨中走了十公里。

examples.en: Goats are hardy animals that live well on the hills.
examples.zh: 山羊是強健的動物，在山坡上也能生活得很好。

examples.en: Most spiders in our garden are harmless.
examples.zh: 我們花園裡的大多數蜘蛛是無害的。

examples.en: The joke was harmless, but she still felt upset.
examples.zh: 這個玩笑沒有惡意，但她還是很難過。

examples.en: This cleaner is harmless to pets and children.
examples.zh: 這款清潔劑對寵物和小孩無害。

examples.en: The small café is a haven for tired students.
examples.zh: 這間小咖啡店是疲憊學生的避風港。

examples.en: The island became a haven for wild birds.
examples.zh: 這座島成了野鳥的庇護所。

examples.en: Her room is a quiet haven after a busy day.
examples.zh: 忙碌一天後，她的房間是個安靜的避風港。

examples.en: The sign warns drivers about hazardous road conditions.
examples.zh: 標誌提醒駕駛人注意危險的路況。

examples.en: Workers must wear masks around hazardous chemicals.
examples.zh: 工作人員在有害化學物質附近必須戴口罩。

examples.en: Climbing on the wet rocks is hazardous.
examples.zh: 攀爬濕滑的岩石很危險。

senses.zh: 迎面相撞的；直接面對的

examples.en: A head-on collision closed the highway for two hours.
examples.zh: 一起正面碰撞事故讓高速公路封閉了兩個小時。

examples.en: The two teams had a head-on battle in the final.
examples.zh: 兩隊在決賽中正面交鋒。

examples.en: The manager chose a head-on approach to the problem.
examples.zh: 經理選擇正面處理這個問題。

examples.en: The two cars crashed head-on near the bridge.
examples.zh: 兩輛車在橋邊迎面相撞。

examples.en: You should face your fears head-on instead of avoiding difficult situations.
examples.zh: 你應該直接面對自己的恐懼，而不是逃避困難的處境。

examples.en: She met the challenge head-on by asking her team for help.
examples.zh: 她向團隊求助，積極正面迎接這項挑戰。

examples.en: Write the title as a heading at the top of the page.
examples.zh: 把題目寫成標題放在頁面最上方。

examples.en: The ship changed its heading to avoid the storm.
examples.zh: 這艘船改變航向以避開暴風雨。

examples.en: Each heading in the report is in bold type.
examples.zh: 報告裡的每個標題都用粗體字。

examples.en: My grandfather's hearing is not as good as before.
examples.zh: 我爺爺的聽力不如從前了。

examples.en: The hearing will take place in the city court next week.
examples.zh: 庭訊將於下週在市法院進行。

examples.en: Residents attended a public hearing about plans for a new airport.
examples.zh: 居民出席了關於新機場計畫的公開聽證會。

examples.en: The two students had a heated argument about the project.
examples.zh: 兩位學生為了這項專題起了激烈的爭論。

examples.en: Heated seats make winter drives more comfortable.
examples.zh: 加熱座椅讓冬天開車更舒適。

examples.en: The meeting became heated after the new proposal.
examples.zh: 新提案提出後，會議上的討論變得激烈。

examples.en: The heating in our classroom is broken again.
examples.zh: 我們教室的暖氣又壞了。

examples.en: Turn down the heating when you go out.
examples.zh: 出門時請把暖氣調低。

examples.en: Heating costs more in the northern part of the country.
examples.zh: 這個國家北部的暖氣費用比較高。

senses.zh: 用力舉起；用力拖拉；發出（嘆息）

examples.en: He heaved the heavy box onto the truck.
examples.zh: 他用力把沉重的箱子抬上貨車。

examples.en: The sailors heaved on the rope together.
examples.zh: 水手們一起用力拉繩子。

examples.en: She heaved a sigh and closed her book.
examples.zh: 她嘆了一口氣，闔上書。

examples.en: With one heave, they moved the table aside.
examples.zh: 他們使勁一推，就把桌子移到旁邊。

examples.en: A big heave brought the net out of the water.
examples.zh: 用力一拉，就把漁網拉出水面。

examples.en: Give the door a heave if it sticks.
examples.zh: 門如果卡住，就用力推一下。

senses.zh: 重量級選手；舉足輕重的人物或機構

examples.en: He trained hard to become a heavyweight boxing champion.
examples.zh: 他努力訓練，想成為重量級拳擊冠軍。

examples.en: The company is a heavyweight in the fashion industry.
examples.zh: 這家公司是時尚業的重量級企業。

examples.en: She is a heavyweight in the field of medicine.
examples.zh: 她是醫學界舉足輕重的人物。

examples.en: The heavyweight match drew a large crowd.
examples.zh: 重量級比賽吸引了大批觀眾。

examples.en: This heavyweight coat will keep you warm all winter.
examples.zh: 這件厚重的外套能讓你整個冬天都保暖。

examples.en: The book offers a heavyweight discussion of world history.
examples.zh: 這本書對世界史有分量十足的討論。

examples.en: You should heed your teacher's advice before the exam.
examples.zh: 考試前你應該聽從老師的建議。

examples.en: Drivers must heed the warning signs on the road.
examples.zh: 駕駛人必須留意路上的警告標誌。

examples.en: He did not heed the doctor's warning about sugar.
examples.zh: 他沒有把醫生關於糖分的警告放在心上。

examples.en: Pay heed to the safety instructions on the label.
examples.zh: 請注意標籤上的安全說明。

examples.en: She took no heed of the loud noise outside.
examples.zh: 她完全沒理會外面的吵鬧聲。

examples.en: Give heed to the rules of the pool.
examples.zh: 請留意泳池的規則。

examples.en: The baby bird was helpless without its mother.
examples.zh: 沒有母鳥在身邊，小鳥顯得無助。

examples.en: I felt helpless when my friend was in trouble.
examples.zh: 朋友遇到麻煩時，我覺得很無能為力。

examples.en: The farmers were helpless against the flood.
examples.zh: 農民面對洪水束手無策。

examples.en: Henceforth, all visitors must sign in at the front desk.
examples.zh: 從今以後，所有訪客都必須在櫃檯簽到。

examples.en: The school announced that henceforth phones will be kept in lockers.
examples.zh: 學校宣布今後手機要放在置物櫃裡。

examples.en: She promised to be on time henceforth.
examples.zh: 她保證從現在起會準時。

examples.en: The first flowers are a herald of spring.
examples.zh: 第一批花朵是春天來臨的預兆。

examples.en: The new phone was a herald of a new age.
examples.zh: 這款新手機是新時代的先驅。

examples.en: Early songs by the band were heralds of its later success.
examples.zh: 這個樂團早期的歌曲是日後成功的前兆。

examples.en: Dark clouds and strong winds often herald a heavy storm.
examples.zh: 烏雲和強風通常預示著一場大風雨。

examples.en: The company will herald the new product next month.
examples.zh: 公司將在下個月宣布新產品。

examples.en: The bell heralded the start of the festival.
examples.zh: 鐘聲宣告慶典開始。

examples.en: The seller will hereafter be referred to as the Company.
examples.zh: 賣方在下文中將稱為「公司」。

examples.en: Hereafter, please send all questions by email.
examples.zh: 今後請以電子郵件寄送所有問題。

examples.en: The rules will apply to all members hereafter.
examples.zh: 這些規定今後適用於所有會員。

examples.en: The old hermit lived alone in a cabin on the mountain.
examples.zh: 那位老隱士獨自住在山上的小木屋裡。

examples.en: After the move, he became something of a hermit.
examples.zh: 搬家以後，他變得有點離群索居。

examples.en: The story is about a hermit who loved books.
examples.zh: 這個故事是關於一位愛書的隱士。

examples.en: Sheep were eating grass on the hillside.
examples.zh: 羊群正在山坡上吃草。

examples.en: Our house sits on a quiet hillside near the lake.
examples.zh: 我們家坐落在湖邊一處安靜的山坡上。

examples.en: Small tea farms cover the hillside above our village.
examples.zh: 小型茶園遍布我們村莊上方的山坡。

examples.en: Heavy rain may hinder the rescue work.
examples.zh: 大雨可能會妨礙救援工作。

examples.en: Noise from the street can hinder your study.
examples.zh: 街上的噪音可能會妨礙你念書。

examples.en: Poor communication will hinder the team's progress.
examples.zh: 溝通不良會阻礙團隊的進度。

examples.en: The door hinge needs a little oil.
examples.zh: 這扇門的鉸鏈需要上一點油。

examples.en: A broken hinge kept the window from closing.
examples.zh: 壞掉的鉸鏈讓窗戶關不起來。

examples.en: The box opens on a small metal hinge.
examples.zh: 這個盒子靠一個小金屬鉸鏈開合。

examples.en: Our plan hinges on the weather, so we will check the forecast.
examples.zh: 我們的計畫取決於天氣，所以我們會查看天氣預報。

examples.en: Everything hinges on whether she can come.
examples.zh: 一切都取決於她能不能來。

examples.en: The result hinges on one final test.
examples.zh: 結果取決於最後一次測驗。

examples.en: The snake began to hiss when we got close.
examples.zh: 我們靠近時，蛇開始發出嘶嘶聲。

examples.en: Steam hissed from the old kettle as the water boiled.
examples.zh: 水燒開時，蒸汽從舊水壺裡嘶嘶地冒出來。

examples.en: The cat hissed at the strange dog.
examples.zh: 貓對著陌生的狗發出嘶嘶聲。

examples.en: We heard a hiss coming from the tire.
examples.zh: 我們聽到輪胎傳來嘶嘶聲。

examples.en: The hiss of the radio made it hard to hear.
examples.zh: 收音機的雜音讓人很難聽清楚。

examples.en: A long hiss came from the pot.
examples.zh: 鍋子裡傳出一陣長長的嘶嘶聲。

examples.en: The fund sold its holding in the company last year.
examples.zh: 這檔基金去年出售了該公司的持股。

examples.en: The library has extensive holdings of old maps and newspapers.
examples.zh: 這座圖書館收藏了大量舊地圖和報紙。

examples.en: Her family's land holding is near the river.
examples.zh: 她家持有的土地在河邊附近。

examples.en: The city opened a shelter for homeless people.
examples.zh: 市政府為無家可歸的人開設了收容所。

examples.en: The fire left many families homeless and in need of shelter.
examples.zh: 那場火災讓許多家庭無家可歸，需要安身之處。

examples.en: We gave warm clothes to the homeless children.
examples.zh: 我們把保暖衣物送給無家可歸的孩子。

examples.en: The town has a fairly homogeneous population.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮的人口組成相當單一。

examples.en: Stir the paint until the mixture is homogeneous in color.
examples.zh: 攪拌油漆，直到混合物的顏色均勻一致。

examples.en: A homogeneous class is easier to teach in some ways.
examples.zh: 程度相近的班級在某些方面比較好教。

examples.en: The driver honked at the car in front of him.
examples.zh: 司機對著前面的車按了喇叭。

examples.en: Geese honk loudly as they fly south.
examples.zh: 鵝群往南飛時會大聲嘎嘎叫。

examples.en: Please do not honk near the hospital.
examples.zh: 請不要在醫院附近按喇叭。

examples.en: We heard the honk of a taxi outside.
examples.zh: 我們聽到外面有計程車的喇叭聲。

examples.en: A loud honk from the bus behind me made me jump.
examples.zh: 後方公車一聲響亮的喇叭聲嚇了我一跳。

examples.en: The honk of geese filled the lake.
examples.zh: 鵝群的叫聲迴盪在湖面上。

examples.en: She pulled up her hood because of the rain.
examples.zh: 因為下雨，她把兜帽拉了起來。

examples.en: The mechanic opened the hood to check the engine.
examples.zh: 技師打開引擎蓋檢查引擎。

examples.en: A warm coat with a hood is good for winter.
examples.zh: 有兜帽的暖外套很適合冬天。

examples.en: The horse hurt its hoof on a sharp stone.
examples.zh: 那匹馬的蹄被尖銳的石頭弄傷了。

examples.en: We heard the sound of hooves on the road.
examples.zh: 我們聽到路上傳來蹄聲。

examples.en: The farmer cleans each hoof carefully to check for small stones.
examples.zh: 農夫仔細清理每隻蹄，檢查是否有小石頭。

senses.zh: 絕望的；毫無希望的；不擅長的

examples.en: He felt hopeless after failing the test twice.
examples.zh: 考試兩次沒過後，他感到絕望。

examples.en: The situation looked hopeless until a neighbor offered to help.
examples.zh: 情況原本看似毫無希望，直到一位鄰居主動伸出援手。

examples.en: I am hopeless at cooking, so I order take-out.
examples.zh: 我很不會做菜，所以都訂外帶餐點。

examples.en: The engine of this truck has 300 horsepower.
examples.zh: 這輛卡車的引擎有三百馬力。

examples.en: More horsepower does not always mean a faster car.
examples.zh: 馬力較大不一定代表車子比較快。

examples.en: The motorbike was tested for its horsepower.
examples.zh: 這輛機車接受了馬力測試。

examples.en: The hound followed the smell along the river.
examples.zh: 獵犬沿著河邊追隨著氣味。

examples.en: A hound can find a path in the dark forest.
examples.zh: 獵犬能在黑暗的森林裡找到路。

examples.en: Our neighbor keeps a hound on his farm.
examples.zh: 我們的鄰居在他的農場養了一隻獵犬。

examples.en: Reporters hounded the actor for an interview.
examples.zh: 記者不斷糾纏那位演員要求採訪。

examples.en: The debt hounded him for years, even after he found a better job.
examples.zh: 即使找到更好的工作，那筆債務仍困擾了他多年。

examples.en: Don't hound your little brother about his homework.
examples.zh: 不要一直催你弟弟寫功課。

senses.zh: 船體；（穀物等的）外殼；草莓蒂頭

examples.en: Workers painted the hull of the ship white.
examples.zh: 工人把船體漆成白色。

examples.en: The rice hull is removed before the grain is polished.
examples.zh: 稻穀在碾白前會先去除稻殼。

examples.en: Remove the hull of the strawberry before eating.
examples.zh: 吃草莓前先去掉蒂頭。

examples.en: The group sends humanitarian aid to flood areas.
examples.zh: 這個團體把人道援助送往水災地區。

examples.en: She won a prize for her humanitarian work.
examples.zh: 她因為人道工作獲得一個獎項。

examples.en: The school raised money for a humanitarian project.
examples.zh: 學校為一項人道專案募款。

examples.en: He is known as a humanitarian who helps children.
examples.zh: 他是以幫助兒童聞名的人道主義者。

examples.en: The humanitarian visited several refugee camps.
examples.zh: 這位人道主義者走訪了幾個難民營。

examples.en: Many humanitarians work without pay to support communities after natural disasters.
examples.zh: 許多人道主義者不領薪水工作，支援遭逢天災的社區。

examples.en: She felt great humiliation when she forgot her speech.
examples.zh: 她忘詞時覺得非常丟臉。

examples.en: The team suffered a humiliation in the final match.
examples.zh: 球隊在決賽中蒙受了羞辱。

examples.en: He could not forget the humiliation of that day.
examples.zh: 他忘不了那天所受的羞辱。

senses.zh: 用力投擲；大聲說出（辱罵的話等）

examples.en: He hurled the ball over the fence.
examples.zh: 他把球用力扔過圍牆。

examples.en: The coach told players not to hurl insults at their opponents.
examples.zh: 教練告訴球員不要辱罵對手。

examples.en: Waves hurled the little boat against the rocks.
examples.zh: 海浪把小船猛力推向岩石。

examples.en: The choir sang a hymn at the morning service.
examples.zh: 合唱團在早晨的禮拜中唱了一首聖歌。

examples.en: We learned an old hymn in music class.
examples.zh: 我們在音樂課學了一首古老的聖歌。

examples.en: Her grandmother hummed a hymn while cooking.
examples.zh: 她奶奶煮飯時哼著聖歌。

examples.en: He was angry at the hypocrisy of the leader.
examples.zh: 他對那位領導者的偽善感到憤怒。

examples.en: Telling others to read while never reading is hypocrisy.
examples.zh: 叫別人讀書自己卻從不讀書，就是虛偽。

examples.en: The article criticizes the hypocrisy of some brands.
examples.zh: 這篇文章批評某些企業的虛偽。

senses.zh: 歇斯底里的；非常好笑的

examples.en: The crowd became hysterical when the singer appeared.
examples.zh: 歌手一出現，群眾就陷入瘋狂。

examples.en: She was hysterical with fear during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間，她嚇得幾乎失控。

examples.en: The comedy was so hysterical that we laughed all night.
examples.zh: 那部喜劇實在太好笑了，我們笑了一整晚。

examples.en: The two parties have deep ideological differences.
examples.zh: 這兩個政黨在意識形態上有很大的差異。

examples.en: The book explains the ideological background of the war.
examples.zh: 這本書說明了這場戰爭的意識形態背景。

examples.en: Students discussed ideological issues raised in the assigned history reading.
examples.zh: 學生討論了指定歷史讀物中提出的意識形態議題。

examples.en: A small spark can ignite dry grass.
examples.zh: 一點小火花就能點燃乾草。

examples.en: The speech ignited a debate among students.
examples.zh: 這場演講引發了學生之間的辯論。

examples.en: Be careful not to ignite the gas near the stove.
examples.zh: 小心不要在爐子附近點燃瓦斯。

examples.en: Immerse the cloth in warm water for ten minutes.
examples.zh: 把布浸在溫水中十分鐘。

examples.en: She immersed herself in her studies before the exam.
examples.zh: 考試前她全心投入功課。

examples.en: Living abroad helps you immerse yourself in the language.
examples.zh: 住在國外能讓你沉浸在語言環境中。

examples.en: Loud noise at work can impair your hearing over time.
examples.zh: 在工作中長期處於吵雜環境可能會損害你的聽力。

examples.en: Lack of sleep will impair your ability to concentrate in class.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足會削弱你在課堂上的專注力。

examples.en: The heavy rain impaired visibility on the highway this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上的大雨使高速公路上的能見度變差。

examples.en: Our teacher likes to impart useful study skills to her students.
examples.zh: 我們的老師喜歡把實用的讀書技巧傳授給學生。

examples.en: A little lemon can impart a fresh taste to the soup.
examples.zh: 加一點檸檬能讓這道湯多一股清爽的味道。

examples.en: The manager called us in to impart some good news.
examples.zh: 經理把我們叫進去，告知一些好消息。

examples.en: The new law gave fresh impetus to the recycling program.
examples.zh: 這項新法律為回收計畫帶來新的推動力。

examples.en: Winning the contest gave her the impetus to keep practicing.
examples.zh: 贏得比賽讓她有動力繼續練習。

examples.en: Lower prices provided the impetus for more people to buy online.
examples.zh: 價格降低刺激了更多人上網購物。

examples.en: The judge sentenced the driver to one year of imprisonment.
examples.zh: 法官判處這名駕駛一年徒刑。

examples.en: Imprisonment takes away a person's freedom for a period of time.
examples.zh: 監禁會在一段時間內剝奪人的自由。

examples.en: Her imprisonment ended after she paid the court's required fine.
examples.zh: 她繳清法院規定的罰款後獲釋。

examples.en: Tom is an impulsive shopper who often buys things he does not need.
examples.zh: 湯姆是個衝動型的購物者，常常買下不需要的東西。

examples.en: It was an impulsive decision, and she regretted it later.
examples.zh: 那是一時衝動的決定，她後來很後悔。

examples.en: Teenagers can be impulsive when they are with their friends.
examples.zh: 青少年和朋友在一起時可能會衝動行事。

examples.en: His inability to swim made him afraid of the deep end.
examples.zh: 他不會游泳，所以很怕深水區。

examples.en: The report noted the school's inability to hire more teachers.
examples.zh: 報告指出學校無力聘請更多老師。

examples.en: Her inability to say no often leaves her with too much work.
examples.zh: 她不懂得拒絕，常讓自己的工作量過多。

senses.zh: 為…舉行就職典禮；為…舉行落成啟用儀式；開創

examples.en: The new mayor will be inaugurated on the first Monday of January.
examples.zh: 新市長將於一月的第一個星期一宣誓就職。

examples.en: The city plans to inaugurate the new library next month.
examples.zh: 市政府計畫下個月為新圖書館舉行啟用典禮。

examples.en: The agreement will inaugurate a new era of cooperation between the two universities.
examples.zh: 這項協議將開創兩所大學合作的新時代。

examples.en: The temple was filled with the smell of burning incense.
examples.zh: 廟裡瀰漫著燃香的氣味。

examples.en: She lit a stick of incense before she started to meditate.
examples.zh: 她在開始靜坐前點了一炷香。

examples.en: Many shops in the old street sell incense and candles.
examples.zh: 老街上有許多店在賣香和蠟燭。

examples.en: The unfair rule incensed many of the parents.
examples.zh: 這項不公平的規定激怒了許多家長。

examples.en: Her rude reply will incense the customer even more.
examples.zh: 她無禮的回應只會讓那位顧客更加憤怒。

examples.en: The long delay incensed passengers waiting at the airport.
examples.zh: 漫長的延誤激怒了在機場等候的乘客。

examples.en: The incidence of flu rises sharply every winter.
examples.zh: 流感的發生率每年冬天都會大幅上升。

examples.en: Doctors are studying the high incidence of allergies among children.
examples.zh: 醫師正在研究孩童過敏的高發生率。

examples.en: The new traffic rules lowered the incidence of accidents near the school.
examples.zh: 新的交通規則降低了學校附近的事故發生率。

examples.en: The hotel charges extra for incidental services such as laundry.
examples.zh: 飯店會針對洗衣等附帶服務另外收費。

examples.en: Our meeting was incidental, but we ended up talking for hours.
examples.zh: 我們的相遇純屬偶然，但最後卻聊了好幾個小時。

examples.en: Music is incidental to the film, not its main feature.
examples.zh: 音樂只是這部電影的附帶元素，不是主要特色。

examples.en: Incidentally, have you finished the homework for tomorrow?
examples.zh: 順帶一提，你寫完明天的作業了嗎？

examples.en: We met incidentally at the station and decided to travel together.
examples.zh: 我們在車站偶然遇見，就決定一起旅行。

examples.en: The store, incidentally, closes an hour earlier on Sundays.
examples.zh: 順帶一提，這家店星期日會提早一小時打烊。

examples.en: The incumbent mayor is running for a second term.
examples.zh: 現任市長正在競選連任。

examples.en: It is incumbent on every student to follow the school rules.
examples.zh: 遵守校規是每位學生的責任。

examples.en: The incumbent champion will play in the final tomorrow.
examples.zh: 現任冠軍明天將出戰決賽。

examples.en: The incumbent has promised to improve the city's public transport.
examples.zh: 現任者承諾會改善這座城市的大眾運輸。

examples.en: Voters in the town chose a new leader instead of the incumbent.
examples.zh: 鎮上的選民選了新領袖，而不是現任者。

examples.en: The incumbent will give a speech at the opening ceremony.
examples.zh: 現任者將在開幕典禮上致詞。

senses.zh: 不確定的；無限期的；模糊的

examples.en: The concert has been postponed for an indefinite period.
examples.zh: 這場演唱會已無限期延後。

examples.en: Her plans for the summer are still indefinite.
examples.zh: 她對暑假的計畫仍不確定。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to avoid indefinite answers in the essay.
examples.zh: 老師要求我們在作文中避免含糊的答案。

examples.en: A high fever is often indicative of an infection.
examples.zh: 高燒常常表示有感染。

examples.en: Her smile was indicative of how happy she was.
examples.zh: 她的笑容顯示出她有多開心。

examples.en: Rising house prices are indicative of growing demand for housing.
examples.zh: 房價上漲顯示住宅需求增加。

examples.en: The unemployment rate is an important indicator of the economy.
examples.zh: 失業率是經濟的重要指標。

examples.en: The fuel indicator shows that the tank is almost empty.
examples.zh: 油量指示器顯示油箱快空了。

examples.en: A red indicator on the screen means the battery is low.
examples.zh: 螢幕上的紅色指示燈表示電量過低。

examples.en: The court received the indictment on Monday morning.
examples.zh: 法院在星期一早上收到了起訴書。

examples.en: The report is a harsh indictment of the city's housing policy.
examples.zh: 這份報告嚴厲批評了市府的住宅政策。

examples.en: The investigation led to the indictment of several company executives.
examples.zh: 這項調查導致數名公司高階主管遭到起訴。

examples.en: The students expressed their indignation at the unfair test results.
examples.zh: 學生們對不公平的考試結果表達了憤慨。

examples.en: She spoke with indignation about the rude treatment she received.
examples.zh: 她憤慨地談起自己受到的無禮對待。

examples.en: There was public indignation over the sudden rise in bus fares.
examples.zh: 公車票價突然上漲引發了民眾的憤慨。

examples.en: Inertia makes passengers lean forward when the bus stops suddenly.
examples.zh: 慣性使公車突然煞車時乘客身體往前傾。

examples.en: It took a lot of effort to overcome my inertia and start exercising.
examples.zh: 我花了很大力氣才克服惰性，開始運動。

examples.en: The company's inertia kept it from adopting new technology.
examples.zh: 這家公司的因循怠惰使它無法採用新科技。

examples.en: The infantry marched through the town during the national parade.
examples.zh: 步兵部隊在國慶遊行中行經市區。

examples.en: My grandfather served in the infantry for two years.
examples.zh: 我的祖父在步兵部隊服役了兩年。

examples.en: The museum has an exhibit about the history of the infantry.
examples.zh: 博物館有一項關於步兵歷史的展覽。

examples.en: She found an ingenious way to store all her books in a small room.
examples.zh: 她想出一個巧妙的方法，把所有書收進小房間裡。

examples.en: The ingenious design of the bridge won an international prize.
examples.zh: 這座橋巧妙的設計贏得了國際大獎。

examples.en: He is an ingenious inventor who makes useful tools from old parts.
examples.zh: 他是個聰明的發明家，會用舊零件做出實用的工具。

examples.en: The students used ingenuity to build a robot from old boxes.
examples.zh: 學生們發揮巧思，用舊紙箱做出了一個機器人。

examples.en: It took great ingenuity to fix the engine without any tools.
examples.zh: 沒有任何工具還要修好引擎，需要很高明的巧思。

examples.en: The team's ingenuity helped it finish the project ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 這個團隊的巧思讓專案提早完成。

examples.en: Fear of making mistakes can inhibit children from speaking English.
examples.zh: 害怕犯錯可能會讓孩子不敢開口說英文。

examples.en: Cold weather inhibits the growth of many plants.
examples.zh: 寒冷的天氣會抑制許多植物的生長。

examples.en: High prices may inhibit people from buying new phones.
examples.zh: 高價格可能使人們不願購買新手機。

examples.en: He felt too inhibited to sing in front of the whole class.
examples.zh: 他覺得太拘謹，不敢在全班面前唱歌。

examples.en: Shy students are often inhibited in group discussions.
examples.zh: 害羞的學生在小組討論時常常放不開。

examples.en: She was less inhibited after spending time with her new friends.
examples.zh: 和新朋友相處一陣子後，她變得比較不拘謹了。

examples.en: The actor lost all his inhibitions once the music began.
examples.zh: 音樂一響起，這位演員就拋開了所有拘束。

examples.en: Doctors tested the inhibition of bacteria by the new medicine.
examples.zh: 醫師測試了這種新藥對細菌的抑制作用。

examples.en: Many people speak with less inhibition when they know their audience well.
examples.zh: 許多人在熟悉聽眾時，說話會比較不拘束。

senses.zh: 小灣；（氣體或液體的）入口

examples.en: We rented a small boat and sailed into a quiet inlet.
examples.zh: 我們租了一艘小船，駛進一處寧靜的小灣。

examples.en: Dust blocked the air inlet of the old machine.
examples.zh: 灰塵堵住了這台舊機器的進氣口。

examples.en: Fishermen gather at the inlet every morning to prepare their nets.
examples.zh: 漁夫每天早上都聚集在小灣整理漁網。

examples.en: The inmate studied English every day in the prison library.
examples.zh: 這名受刑人每天都在監獄圖書館裡讀英文。

examples.en: Each inmate at the center has a small room and a bed.
examples.zh: 這個中心的每位被收容者都有一間小房間和一張床。

examples.en: A teacher visits the prison once a week to help every inmate.
examples.zh: 老師每週會去監獄一次，協助每位受刑人。

examples.en: Please keep the insecticide away from small children.
examples.zh: 請把殺蟲劑放在小孩拿不到的地方。

examples.en: My uncle sprays insecticide on the vegetables to protect them from bugs.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在蔬菜上噴殺蟲劑，以免被蟲子吃掉。

examples.en: This insecticide is safe to use inside the house.
examples.zh: 這種殺蟲劑可以安全地在室內使用。

senses.zh: 缺乏安全感的；缺乏自信的；不穩固的

examples.en: She felt insecure about speaking English in front of strangers.
examples.zh: 她在陌生人面前說英文會感到沒自信。

examples.en: The old ladder looks insecure, so please do not climb it.
examples.zh: 這座舊梯子看起來不穩固，請不要爬。

examples.en: Many people feel insecure when their job might disappear.
examples.zh: 許多人在工作可能不保時會感到不安。

examples.en: An insider told the reporter that the company would move offices.
examples.zh: 一位內部人士告訴記者，這家公司將搬遷辦公室。

examples.en: As an insider, he knew how the club chose new members.
examples.zh: 他身為內部人士，知道社團如何挑選新成員。

examples.en: The book gives readers an insider's view of the movie industry.
examples.zh: 這本書讓讀者一窺電影業的內幕。

senses.zh: 堅持不讓步的；急切而持續的

examples.en: The child was insistent that he could tie his shoes alone.
examples.zh: 那個孩子堅持自己能綁鞋帶。

examples.en: An insistent knock on the door woke us up early.
examples.zh: 一陣急切而持續的敲門聲一大早就把我們吵醒了。

examples.en: Customers were insistent on getting their money back.
examples.zh: 顧客堅持要求退費。

examples.en: The instability of the old bridge worried many drivers.
examples.zh: 那座舊橋的不穩固令許多駕駛感到擔心。

examples.en: Economic instability made it hard for small shops to plan ahead.
examples.zh: 經濟不穩定使小型商店很難做長遠的規劃。

examples.en: Emotional instability can affect a student's schoolwork.
examples.zh: 情緒不穩定可能會影響學生的課業。

senses.zh: 分期款項；連載或系列作品的一集

examples.en: I bought the laptop by paying in monthly installments.
examples.zh: 我用每月分期付款的方式買了這台筆記型電腦。

examples.en: The first installment of the rent is due on Friday.
examples.zh: 第一期房租在星期五到期。

examples.en: The next installment of the series comes out in March.
examples.zh: 這個系列的下一集將在三月推出。

examples.en: The effect of the medicine was almost instantaneous.
examples.zh: 這種藥的效果幾乎是立即顯現的。

examples.en: Online chat makes instantaneous communication possible across countries.
examples.zh: 網路聊天讓跨國即時溝通成為可能。

examples.en: Her reaction to the loud noise was instantaneous.
examples.zh: 她對巨大的聲響立即做出反應。

examples.en: The university offers institutional support to new students.
examples.zh: 這所大學為新生提供校方支援。

examples.en: Institutional rules at the hospital require all visitors to wear masks.
examples.zh: 這家醫院規定，所有訪客都必須戴口罩。

examples.en: The company is making institutional changes to improve fairness.
examples.zh: 這家公司正在進行制度上的改革以提升公平性。

examples.en: Her advice was instrumental in helping me choose a major.
examples.zh: 她的建議對我選擇主修科系起了重要作用。

examples.en: My uncle was instrumental in setting up the new community center.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在籌設新的社區活動中心時扮演了重要角色。

examples.en: We listened to a soft instrumental piece during dinner.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐時聽了一首輕柔的器樂曲。

examples.en: Thick curtains can insulate a room against noise from the street.
examples.zh: 厚窗簾可以為房間隔音，減少街上的噪音傳入。

examples.en: We insulated the roof to keep the house cool in summer.
examples.zh: 我們替屋頂做了隔熱，讓房子夏天保持涼爽。

examples.en: Rubber is used to insulate electric wires.
examples.zh: 橡膠被用來為電線絕緣。

examples.en: He insured his new car against theft and accidents.
examples.zh: 他為新車投保了竊盜險和意外險。

examples.en: Travelers should insure their luggage before a long trip.
examples.zh: 旅客在長途旅行前應該為行李投保。

examples.en: Please insure that every door is locked before you leave.
examples.zh: 離開前請確保每一扇門都已上鎖。

examples.en: My insurer paid for the repairs to the car.
examples.zh: 我的保險公司支付了修車費用。

examples.en: The insurer asked for more documents before approving the claim.
examples.zh: 保險公司在核准理賠前要求提供更多文件。

examples.en: Our insurer offers a discount for safe drivers.
examples.zh: 我們的保險公司為安全駕駛人提供折扣。

senses.zh: 不可或缺的；構成整體的

examples.en: Teamwork is an integral part of our school's sports program.
examples.zh: 團隊合作是我們學校運動課程不可或缺的一部分。

examples.en: Fresh vegetables are integral to a healthy diet.
examples.zh: 新鮮蔬菜是健康飲食不可或缺的一環。

examples.en: The kitchen is an integral part of the apartment's design.
examples.zh: 廚房是這間公寓設計中不可分割的一部分。

examples.en: The instructions were clear and intelligible to everyone.
examples.zh: 這份說明清楚易懂，每個人都看得懂。

examples.en: His speech was barely intelligible because of the bad microphone.
examples.zh: 由於麥克風不好，他的演講幾乎聽不清楚。

examples.en: The teacher made the difficult lesson intelligible with simple examples.
examples.zh: 老師用簡單的例子讓困難的課程變得容易理解。

examples.en: The family will inter their grandfather in the village cemetery.
examples.zh: 家人將把祖父安葬在村裡的墓園。

examples.en: Many famous writers are interred in this old churchyard.
examples.zh: 許多知名作家都安葬在這座古老的教堂墓地。

examples.en: The ceremony to inter the old soldier was held on Sunday.
examples.zh: 那位老兵的安葬儀式在星期日舉行。

examples.en: The two countries have had friendly intercourse for many years.
examples.zh: 這兩個國家多年來一直保持友好往來。

examples.en: Social intercourse helps students learn how to work with others.
examples.zh: 社交往來能幫助學生學會與他人合作。

examples.en: Trade and cultural intercourse grew after the new railway opened.
examples.zh: 新鐵路開通後，貿易與文化交流日益增加。

examples.en: An interim manager will lead the team until June.
examples.zh: 在六月之前，將由一位臨時經理帶領這個團隊。

examples.en: The school made an interim plan while the gym was being repaired.
examples.zh: 體育館整修期間，學校制定了臨時計畫。

examples.en: The interim report will be sent to parents next week.
examples.zh: 期中報告將於下週寄給家長。

examples.en: In the interim, please use the side entrance.
examples.zh: 在這段期間，請使用側門進出。

examples.en: The club met online in the interim between the two events.
examples.zh: 兩場活動之間的這段期間，社團在線上聚會。

examples.en: She worked at a bookstore in the interim before starting college.
examples.zh: 在進大學之前的空檔，她在書店工作。

examples.en: We had intermittent rain throughout the school trip.
examples.zh: 整趟校外教學期間，雨時下時停。

examples.en: The intermittent noise from the street made it hard to sleep.
examples.zh: 街上斷斷續續的噪音讓人很難入睡。

examples.en: The Wi-Fi in the hotel was intermittent all weekend.
examples.zh: 整個週末，這家飯店的無線網路時好時壞。

senses.zh: 錯綜複雜的；繁複精細的

examples.en: The museum displays an intricate pattern woven by hand.
examples.zh: 博物館展示著一幅手工編織的精細圖案。

examples.en: The rules of the board game are too intricate for young children.
examples.zh: 這款桌遊的規則對年幼的孩子來說太複雜了。

examples.en: She drew an intricate map of the whole neighborhood.
examples.zh: 她畫了一張涵蓋整個社區、細節繁複的地圖。

examples.en: Good teachers know that curiosity is an intrinsic part of learning.
examples.zh: 好老師知道好奇心是學習本質的一部分。

examples.en: The ring has little intrinsic value, but it means a lot to her.
examples.zh: 這枚戒指本身的價值不高，但對她意義重大。

examples.en: Many students find an intrinsic reward in learning new skills.
examples.zh: 許多學生從學習新技能中得到內在的成就感。

examples.en: Sorry for the intrusion, but may I ask you a quick question?
examples.zh: 抱歉打擾，我可以簡短地問你一個問題嗎？

examples.en: The alarm warned us of an intrusion into the building.
examples.zh: 警報器通知我們有人闖入大樓。

examples.en: Many people see constant phone calls as an intrusion on their private time.
examples.zh: 許多人認為不斷的來電是對私人時間的打擾。

examples.en: Your ticket is invalid because it has already expired.
examples.zh: 你的票已經過期，所以無效。

examples.en: The system said my password was invalid, so I tried again.
examples.zh: 系統顯示我的密碼無效，所以我又試了一次。

examples.en: His argument is invalid because it relies on false assumptions.
examples.zh: 他的論點建立在錯誤假設上，因此站不住腳。

examples.en: My uncle follows an invariable morning routine before leaving for work.
examples.zh: 我叔叔上班出門前總是遵循固定的晨間作息。

examples.en: The price of the ticket is invariable, whatever the season.
examples.zh: 不論季節，票價都一成不變。

examples.en: The machine operates at an invariable speed throughout the test.
examples.zh: 這台機器在整個測試過程中都以不變的速度運轉。

senses.zh: 倒置；顛倒順序；反轉顏色

examples.en: Invert the cup and place it on the towel to dry.
examples.zh: 把杯子倒過來放在毛巾上晾乾。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to invert the order of the two numbers.
examples.zh: 老師要我們把這兩個數字的順序顛倒。

examples.en: The photo editor can invert the colors of any picture.
examples.zh: 這個修圖軟體可以把任何圖片的顏色反轉。

examples.en: The warm kitchen smelled inviting after a long day at school.
examples.zh: 上了一整天的課後，溫暖的廚房聞起來很誘人。

examples.en: The hotel has an inviting lobby with soft chairs and fresh flowers.
examples.zh: 這間飯店的大廳很吸引人，有柔軟的椅子和新鮮的花。

examples.en: The cool, clear water of the lake looked very inviting.
examples.zh: 湖裡清涼又清澈的水看起來讓人很想下去。

examples.en: Parents' involvement in school activities helps children do better.
examples.zh: 家長參與學校活動有助於孩子表現得更好。

examples.en: The company denied any involvement in the accident.
examples.zh: 公司否認與這起意外有任何牽連。

examples.en: Her involvement in the project started last spring.
examples.zh: 她從去年春天開始參與這個專案。

examples.en: The door has an inward curve that makes it hard to open.
examples.zh: 這扇門有向內的弧度，所以很難打開。

examples.en: She felt an inward sense of calm before the speech.
examples.zh: 演講前，她內心感到一股平靜。

examples.en: An inward glance at his own habits helped him change.
examples.zh: 他審視自己的習慣，因而有所改變。

examples.en: The windows of the old house open inward.
examples.zh: 這棟老房子的窗戶向內開。

examples.en: The box was folded inward to save space.
examples.zh: 這個盒子被向內摺起來以節省空間。

examples.en: Please turn the handle inward and then pull it.
examples.zh: 請把把手往內轉，然後拉開。

examples.en: The test is designed to measure a child's IQ.
examples.zh: 這項測驗是用來測量孩子的智商。

examples.en: A high IQ does not always mean a person is successful.
examples.zh: 高智商不一定代表一個人會成功。

examples.en: Our teacher said that IQ tests measure only some aspects of intelligence.
examples.zh: 老師說，智商測驗只能測量智力的部分面向。

examples.en: The smell of fresh bread was irresistible to everyone in the shop.
examples.zh: 新鮮麵包的香味讓店裡的每個人都難以抗拒。

examples.en: The store is offering an irresistible discount this weekend.
examples.zh: 這家店本週末推出令人無法抗拒的折扣。

examples.en: The puppy's irresistible smile made us want to take it home.
examples.zh: 小狗那令人難以抗拒的笑臉讓我們想把牠帶回家。

examples.en: The club welcomes all students, irrespective of their grades.
examples.zh: 這個社團歡迎所有學生，不論成績如何。

examples.en: Tickets are sold on a first-come basis, irrespective of age.
examples.zh: 門票依先到先得販售，不分年齡。

examples.en: Irrespective of the weather, the game will start at noon.
examples.zh: 不論天氣如何，比賽都會在中午開始。

examples.en: Farmers in this area depend on irrigation during the dry season.
examples.zh: 這個地區的農民在乾季要靠灌溉。

examples.en: The government built a new irrigation system near the river.
examples.zh: 政府在河邊建造了新的灌溉系統。

examples.en: Good irrigation can double the amount of rice a farm produces.
examples.zh: 良好的灌溉可以讓農場的稻米產量加倍。

senses.zh: 惱怒；（皮膚等的）刺激不適；惱人的事物

examples.en: He could not hide his irritation when the bus was late again.
examples.zh: 公車又誤點時，他藏不住心中的惱怒。

examples.en: The cream helps reduce skin irritation caused by the sun.
examples.zh: 這款乳霜有助於減輕日曬造成的皮膚刺激不適。

examples.en: The loud music was a constant irritation to our neighbors.
examples.zh: 吵鬧的音樂讓鄰居們一直很心煩。

examples.en: Dad used a jack to lift the car and change the tire.
examples.zh: 爸爸用千斤頂把車抬起來換輪胎。

examples.en: Plug the headphones into the jack on the side of the laptop.
examples.zh: 把耳機插進筆電側邊的插孔。

examples.en: She played the jack of hearts and won the card game.
examples.zh: 她打出紅心 J，贏了這場紙牌遊戲。

examples.en: Students are told not to jaywalk in front of the school.
examples.zh: 學生被告知不要在學校前面亂穿越馬路。

examples.en: Many people jaywalk when the street looks empty.
examples.zh: 許多人在馬路上看起來沒車時就亂穿越馬路。

examples.en: The sign warns people not to jaywalk at this busy corner.
examples.zh: 告示牌提醒大家不要在這個繁忙的路口亂穿越馬路。

examples.en: Some fans began to jeer when the team lost the ball.
examples.zh: 球隊失誤丟球時，一些球迷開始奚落。

examples.en: It is rude to jeer at someone who makes a mistake.
examples.zh: 嘲笑犯錯的人是很沒禮貌的。

examples.en: The crowd jeered at the singer after he forgot the words.
examples.zh: 歌手忘詞後，群眾對他發出嘲笑聲。

examples.en: A loud jeer came from the back of the room.
examples.zh: 房間後方傳來一聲響亮的譏笑。

examples.en: He ignored the jeers and kept playing the piano.
examples.zh: 他不理會那些嘲笑，繼續彈鋼琴。

examples.en: The speaker was met with cheers and a few jeers.
examples.zh: 講者受到一片歡呼，也有幾聲嘲笑。

examples.en: Skipping safety checks could jeopardize the whole trip.
examples.zh: 省略安全檢查可能會危害整趟旅程。

examples.en: Poor grades may jeopardize his chance of entering that school.
examples.zh: 成績不好可能會危及他進入那所學校的機會。

examples.en: The delay will jeopardize our plan to open the store on time.
examples.zh: 這次延誤將危及我們準時開店的計畫。

examples.en: He jerked the door open and ran outside.
examples.zh: 他猛然拉開門，衝了出去。

examples.en: The bus jerked forward and the passengers almost fell.
examples.zh: 公車猛然向前一晃，乘客差點跌倒。

examples.en: She jerked her hand away from the hot pan.
examples.zh: 她猛地把手從熱鍋子上縮開。

senses.zh: 突然的猛動；混蛋（非正式貶義）

examples.en: The train stopped with a sudden jerk.
examples.zh: 火車突然猛地停了下來。

examples.en: With one jerk, he pulled the heavy box off the shelf.
examples.zh: 他用力一拉，把沉重的箱子從架上拉了下來。

examples.en: Nobody likes working with a jerk who ignores other people.
examples.zh: 沒有人喜歡和不顧別人的混蛋共事。

examples.en: My brother wears his baseball jersey to every game.
examples.zh: 我哥哥每場比賽都穿他的棒球球衣。

examples.en: Her new dress is made of soft, stretchy jersey.
examples.zh: 她的新洋裝是用柔軟、有彈性的針織布製成的。

examples.en: The warm wool jersey kept him comfortable on the cold hike.
examples.zh: 這件溫暖的羊毛針織衫讓他在寒冷的健行中很舒適。

examples.en: Many jobless workers attended the job fair this weekend.
examples.zh: 許多失業勞工參加了本週末的就業博覽會。

examples.en: He was jobless for six months before he found a new position.
examples.zh: 他失業了六個月才找到新職位。

examples.en: The city is helping jobless young people learn new skills.
examples.zh: 市府正在協助失業的年輕人學習新技能。

examples.en: The judiciary is independent from the government.
examples.zh: 司法機關獨立於行政部門。

examples.en: Students visited the court to learn how the judiciary works.
examples.zh: 學生們參觀法院，了解司法系統如何運作。

examples.en: A fair judiciary is important for a healthy society.
examples.zh: 公正的司法體系對健全的社會很重要。

senses.zh: 套頭毛衣（英式）；無袖連身裙（美式）；跳躍者

examples.en: She is the best high jumper on our school team.
examples.zh: 她是我們校隊中最厲害的跳高選手。

examples.en: Mom knitted a warm jumper for my little sister.
examples.zh: 媽媽為我妹妹織了一件溫暖的套頭毛衣。

examples.en: The school uniform includes a blue jumper worn over a white shirt.
examples.zh: 這所學校的制服包含一件穿在白襯衫外的藍色無袖連身裙。

examples.en: There is no justification for being rude to customers.
examples.zh: 對顧客無禮是沒有正當理由的。

examples.en: The manager asked for a clear justification of the extra cost.
examples.zh: 經理要求清楚說明這筆額外費用的理由。

examples.en: Her late arrival needs no justification because the train broke down.
examples.zh: 她遲到不需要辯解，因為火車故障了。

examples.en: Her anger was justified because the waiter forgot her order twice.
examples.zh: 服務生兩度忘了她點的餐，她的生氣是合理的。

examples.en: The teacher felt justified in giving the student extra homework.
examples.zh: 老師覺得給那位學生額外的作業是合理的。

examples.en: The high price is justified by the excellent quality.
examples.zh: 優良的品質使這個高價格有其道理。

examples.en: Each kernel of corn is covered with a thin skin.
examples.zh: 每一粒玉米的外面都包著一層薄皮。

examples.en: He cracked the nut and ate the sweet kernel inside.
examples.zh: 他敲開堅果，吃掉裡面香甜的果仁。

examples.en: The kernel of her speech was that everyone should help.
examples.zh: 她演講的核心就是大家都應該幫忙。

examples.en: Heart disease is a major killer in many countries.
examples.zh: 心臟病在許多國家是主要的致命疾病。

examples.en: The detective spent years looking for the killer.
examples.zh: 那位偵探花了好幾年尋找兇手。

examples.en: Stress is a silent killer that affects many office workers.
examples.zh: 壓力是無聲的殺手，影響許多上班族。

senses.zh: 致命的；極出色的（非正式）

examples.en: The science lesson explained how killer diseases spread through communities.
examples.zh: 科學課說明了致命疾病如何在社區傳播。

examples.en: She prepared a killer presentation for the meeting.
examples.zh: 她為這場會議準備了一份超棒的簡報。

examples.en: The weather report warned hikers about a killer heat wave.
examples.zh: 氣象報告提醒登山客留意致命的熱浪。

examples.en: The killing of wild animals is against the law here.
examples.zh: 在這裡，獵殺野生動物是違法的。

examples.en: The newspaper reported a killing near the old harbor.
examples.zh: 報紙報導了舊港口附近的一起殺人案。

examples.en: He made a killing by selling his old comic books online.
examples.zh: 他在網路上賣掉舊漫畫書，大賺了一筆。

examples.en: The company has the know-how to build fast trains.
examples.zh: 這家公司有建造高速列車的技術。

examples.en: Learning to cook takes practice and some basic know-how.
examples.zh: 學做菜需要練習，也要有一些基本的訣竅。

examples.en: We need someone with technical know-how to fix the network.
examples.zh: 我們需要一位有技術知識的人來修理網路。

examples.en: He knocked on the door with his knuckle.
examples.zh: 他用指關節敲了敲門。

examples.en: She hurt her knuckle when she hit the table by mistake.
examples.zh: 她不小心撞到桌子，弄傷了指關節。

examples.en: The boxer wrapped tape around each knuckle before practice.
examples.zh: 拳擊手練習前在每個指關節上纏上膠帶。

senses.zh: 跛的；差勁的；站不住腳的

examples.en: The lame horse could not run in the race.
examples.zh: 那匹跛腳的馬無法參加賽跑。

examples.en: I thought the movie was lame, so I left early.
examples.zh: 我覺得那部電影很差勁，所以提早離開了。

examples.en: His excuse for missing class was too lame to believe.
examples.zh: 他缺課的藉口太站不住腳，讓人無法相信。

examples.en: Fans lament the loss of the old stadium.
examples.zh: 球迷們為舊球場的消失感到惋惜。

examples.en: She lamented the fact that summer vacation was over.
examples.zh: 她為暑假結束這件事感到惋惜。

examples.en: Many parents lament how little time they have with their kids.
examples.zh: 許多家長感嘆自己和孩子相處的時間太少。

examples.en: The singer wrote a lament for her lost home town.
examples.zh: 這位歌手為失去的家鄉寫了一首哀歌。

examples.en: A long lament rose from the crowd.
examples.zh: 群眾中傳出一陣長長的悲嘆。

examples.en: His lament about the high rent was heard by everyone.
examples.zh: 他對高房租的抱怨大家都聽到了。

examples.en: The plane made a smooth landing despite the strong wind.
examples.zh: 儘管風很大，飛機仍平穩降落。

examples.en: We waited on the landing between the first and second floors.
examples.zh: 我們在一樓與二樓之間的樓梯平台等候。

examples.en: The pilot announced that the landing would be in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 機長廣播十分鐘後就要降落。

examples.en: The city plans a large-scale project to improve public parks.
examples.zh: 市府計畫推動大規模的專案來改善公園。

examples.en: There was a large-scale sale at the mall this weekend.
examples.zh: 這個週末購物中心有一場大規模的促銷。

examples.en: Large-scale farming needs a lot of water and machines.
examples.zh: 大規模的農耕需要大量的水和機器。

examples.en: She put mascara on her lashes before the party.
examples.zh: 派對前，她在睫毛上刷了睫毛膏。

examples.en: The rider gave the horse a light lash with the whip.
examples.zh: 騎士用鞭子輕輕抽了馬一下。

examples.en: A dust particle on his lash made his eye water.
examples.zh: 睫毛上的一粒灰塵讓他的眼睛流淚。

examples.en: Heavy rain lashed the windows all night.
examples.zh: 大雨整晚猛烈拍打著窗戶。

examples.en: The sailors lashed the boxes to the deck.
examples.zh: 水手們把箱子綁在甲板上。

examples.en: The coach lashed out at the team for their careless play.
examples.zh: 教練為球隊粗心的表現痛罵了一頓。

examples.en: The trip left us with lasting memories of the beautiful coast.
examples.zh: 這趟旅行讓我們對美麗的海岸留下了長久的回憶。

examples.en: They hope to build a lasting friendship with their new classmates.
examples.zh: 他們希望和新同學建立長久的友誼。

examples.en: Good habits can have a lasting effect on your health.
examples.zh: 好習慣能對你的健康產生長遠的影響。

examples.en: Every child has latent talents that teachers can help bring out.
examples.zh: 每個孩子都有潛在的才能，老師可以幫忙發掘出來。

examples.en: The virus can stay latent in the body for years.
examples.zh: 這種病毒可以在體內潛伏數年。

examples.en: There was a latent conflict between the two departments.
examples.zh: 這兩個部門之間存在著潛在的衝突。

examples.en: Hot lava flowed slowly down the side of the volcano.
examples.zh: 熾熱的熔岩沿著火山側邊緩緩流下。

examples.en: The lava cooled and turned into black rock.
examples.zh: 熔岩冷卻後變成了黑色的岩石。

examples.en: Scientists watched the lava from a safe distance.
examples.zh: 科學家從安全的距離觀察熔岩。

examples.en: This laptop has a bright LCD that is easy on the eyes.
examples.zh: 這台筆電的液晶螢幕明亮，看起來很舒服。

examples.en: The LCD on the microwave shows the time.
examples.zh: 微波爐上的液晶顯示器會顯示時間。

examples.en: Dad bought a new LCD for his home office.
examples.zh: 爸爸為他的家庭辦公室買了一台新的液晶螢幕。

examples.en: The teacher used a short story as a lead-in to the lesson.
examples.zh: 老師用一則小故事作為這堂課的開場。

examples.en: Her joke was a good lead-in to the main topic.
examples.zh: 她的笑話是切入主題的好開場。

examples.en: The lead-in to the news report was too long.
examples.zh: 這則新聞報導的引言太長了。

examples.en: The boat anchored in the lee of the island to avoid the wind.
examples.zh: 船停泊在島的背風處以避風。

examples.en: We sat in the lee of the wall and had our lunch.
examples.zh: 我們坐在牆的避風處吃午餐。

examples.en: The sailors sheltered in the lee of the rocks until the storm passed.
examples.zh: 水手們躲在岩石的背風處，直到風暴過去。

examples.en: The newspaper is known for its left-wing views.
examples.zh: 這份報紙以左派觀點聞名。

examples.en: He joined a left-wing group at university.
examples.zh: 他在大學時加入了一個左派團體。

examples.en: The left-wing party promised to raise the minimum wage.
examples.zh: 這個左翼政黨承諾要提高基本工資。

examples.en: The legislature passed a new law to protect rivers.
examples.zh: 立法機關通過了一項保護河川的新法律。

examples.en: Members of the legislature meet in the capital every year.
examples.zh: 立法機關的成員每年都在首都開會。

examples.en: Our class took a field trip to visit the state legislature.
examples.zh: 我們班去校外教學，參觀了州議會。

examples.en: Choose the lesser of the two prices if the quality is the same.
examples.zh: 如果品質相同，就選兩者中較便宜的價格。

examples.en: The second storm was of lesser intensity than the first.
examples.zh: 第二場暴風雨的強度比第一場弱。

examples.en: He cares more about grades than about lesser matters like clothes.
examples.zh: 他比較在乎成績，而不是衣服之類較次要的事。

examples.en: Push the lever down to open the box.
examples.zh: 把操縱桿往下壓，就能打開箱子。

examples.en: A long lever makes it easier to lift a heavy rock.
examples.zh: 長長的槓桿讓人更容易抬起沉重的石頭。

examples.en: The company used low prices as a lever to win new customers.
examples.zh: 公司以低價作為手段來爭取新客戶。

examples.en: He levered the lid off the paint can with a spoon.
examples.zh: 他用湯匙把油漆桶的蓋子撬開。

examples.en: The workers levered the stone out of the ground.
examples.zh: 工人們把石頭從地裡撬了出來。

examples.en: She levered open the window with a small tool.
examples.zh: 她用一把小工具把窗戶撬開。

examples.en: The city added a small levy to every plastic bag.
examples.zh: 市政府對每個塑膠袋加徵一小筆稅。

examples.en: Companies must pay a levy on imported goods.
examples.zh: 公司必須為進口貨物繳納稅款。

examples.en: The new levy will help pay for public transport.
examples.zh: 這項新的稅款將用來補助大眾運輸。

examples.en: The government decided to levy a tax on sugary drinks.
examples.zh: 政府決定對含糖飲料課稅。

examples.en: Some towns levy fees on tourists who stay overnight.
examples.zh: 有些城鎮向過夜的遊客徵收費用。

examples.en: The school may levy a fine for late library books.
examples.zh: 學校可能會對逾期未還的圖書收取罰款。

examples.en: The singer sued the magazine for libel.
examples.zh: 那位歌手控告這本雜誌誹謗。

examples.en: Printing false stories about a person can be libel.
examples.zh: 刊登不實的報導來中傷某人可能構成誹謗。

examples.en: The court decided that the article was not libel.
examples.zh: 法院判定這篇文章不構成誹謗。

examples.en: The government plans to liberalize trade with other countries.
examples.zh: 政府計畫放寬與其他國家的貿易管制。

examples.en: Many countries liberalized their rules for foreign visitors.
examples.zh: 許多國家放寬了對外國旅客的規定。

examples.en: The company wants to liberalize its dress code for office workers.
examples.zh: 公司想放寬上班族的服裝規定。

examples.en: Every passenger must know where the lifeboat is on the ship.
examples.zh: 每位乘客都必須知道船上的救生艇在哪裡。

examples.en: The crew lowered a lifeboat into the water.
examples.zh: 船員把救生艇放到水面上。

examples.en: Children and elderly people were helped into the lifeboat first.
examples.zh: 孩童和年長者先被協助上了救生艇。

examples.en: The lighting in the library is soft and good for reading.
examples.zh: 圖書館的燈光柔和，很適合閱讀。

examples.en: We changed the lighting in the living room to save energy.
examples.zh: 我們更換了客廳的照明設備以節省能源。

examples.en: Good lighting makes the photo look much better.
examples.zh: 良好的燈光讓這張照片看起來好很多。

examples.en: I bought a lightweight jacket for the trip.
examples.zh: 我為這趟旅行買了一件輕便的外套。

examples.en: This lightweight laptop is easy to carry to class.
examples.zh: 這台輕巧的筆電很方便帶去上課。

examples.en: The lightweight tent can be packed into a small bag.
examples.zh: 這頂輕量帳篷可以收進一個小袋子裡。

senses.zh: 輕量級；體重較輕的人；無足輕重的人物（貶義）

examples.en: The boxer moved up from lightweight to a heavier group.
examples.zh: 這位拳擊手從輕量級升到了較重的量級。

examples.en: Many people think of him as a lightweight in politics.
examples.zh: 許多人認為他在政壇上是個無足輕重的人物。

examples.en: She is a lightweight at only forty-five kilograms.
examples.zh: 她只有四十五公斤，是個體重較輕的人。

examples.en: Add a slice of lime to the cold drink.
examples.zh: 在冰飲裡加一片萊姆。

examples.en: The farmer spread lime on the soil to help the plants grow.
examples.zh: 農夫把石灰撒在土壤上，幫助植物生長。

examples.en: She squeezed fresh lime juice over the fish.
examples.zh: 她把新鮮的萊姆汁擠在魚上。

senses.zh: 大型豪華轎車；機場接駁車

examples.en: A black limousine was waiting outside the hotel.
examples.zh: 一輛黑色豪華轎車正在飯店外等候。

examples.en: The bride arrived at the church in a white limousine.
examples.zh: 新娘乘坐白色豪華轎車抵達教堂。

examples.en: We took the airport limousine to the city center.
examples.zh: 我們搭機場接駁車前往市中心。

senses.zh: 直線的；線性的；按順序發展的

examples.en: The graph shows a linear increase in sales.
examples.zh: 這張圖顯示銷售額呈線性成長。

examples.en: In math class, we learned how to solve a linear equation.
examples.zh: 我們在數學課學會了如何解線性方程式。

examples.en: The story does not follow a linear order from start to end.
examples.zh: 這個故事並不是依照時間先後順序從頭說到尾。

senses.zh: 陣容；節目表；（供警方指認的）列隊

examples.en: The coach announced the starting lineup before the game.
examples.zh: 教練在比賽前公布了先發陣容。

examples.en: The witness identified the suspect in a lineup at the police station.
examples.zh: 目擊者在警局的指認列隊中認出了嫌疑人。

examples.en: The TV station changed its Friday night lineup.
examples.zh: 這家電視台更動了週五晚間的節目陣容。

senses.zh: 語言學家；精通多國語言的人

examples.en: The linguist studies how children learn their first language.
examples.zh: 這位語言學家研究孩子如何學會第一種語言。

examples.en: My aunt is a talented linguist who speaks five languages.
examples.zh: 我阿姨是很有天分的語言通，會說五種語言。

examples.en: A famous linguist gave a talk at our university.
examples.zh: 一位知名的語言學家在我們大學演講。

senses.zh: 照字面地；確實地；簡直（非正式誇張用法）

examples.en: The sign literally means "no entry" in Chinese.
examples.zh: 這個標誌的中文字面意思是「禁止進入」。

examples.en: I was literally dying of laughter during the school play.
examples.zh: 看學校的戲劇表演時，我簡直笑死了。

examples.en: The shop was literally empty when we arrived at noon.
examples.zh: 我們中午抵達時，那間店裡真的空無一人。

examples.en: They hired a live-in nurse to care for their grandmother.
examples.zh: 他們請了一位住家護理師來照顧奶奶。

examples.en: My aunt works as a live-in housekeeper for a family in Taipei.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在台北一戶人家擔任住家管家。

examples.en: Her live-in partner helps with the cooking and housework.
examples.zh: 她的同居伴侶會幫忙做飯和家務。

examples.en: What do you do for a living?
examples.zh: 你是做什麼工作維生的？

examples.en: She makes a living by teaching English online.
examples.zh: 她靠線上教英文維生。

examples.en: The cost of living in big cities keeps rising.
examples.zh: 大城市的生活開銷持續上漲。

examples.en: The museum has a living example of this rare plant.
examples.zh: 博物館裡有這種稀有植物的活體樣本。

examples.en: He is the oldest living member of our family.
examples.zh: 他是我們家族中現存最年長的成員。

examples.en: All living things need water to survive and grow.
examples.zh: 所有生物都需要水才能存活並生長。

examples.en: The llama stood quietly behind the wooden fence.
examples.zh: 那隻駱馬安靜地站在木柵欄後面。

examples.en: Farmers in Peru use a llama to carry heavy bags up the mountain.
examples.zh: 秘魯的農夫用駱馬把重袋子運上山。

examples.en: Our class took photos with a friendly llama at the zoo.
examples.zh: 我們班在動物園和一隻友善的駱馬合照。

senses.zh: 裝載好的；已裝彈的；有錢的（非正式）

examples.en: The truck was loaded with boxes of fresh vegetables.
examples.zh: 這輛卡車載著一箱箱新鮮蔬菜。

examples.en: The officer discovered that the abandoned gun was still loaded.
examples.zh: 警員發現那把被遺棄的槍仍裝有子彈。

examples.en: His uncle is loaded, so he never worries about money.
examples.zh: 他叔叔很有錢，所以從不擔心錢的問題。

examples.en: Several new shops have opened in our locality this year.
examples.zh: 今年我們這一帶開了好幾家新店。

examples.en: The hotel is in a quiet locality near the river.
examples.zh: 這間飯店位在河邊一處安靜的地區。

examples.en: Please give us details about the locality of the accident.
examples.zh: 請提供事故發生地點的詳細資訊。

examples.en: The front door was locked when I got home.
examples.zh: 我回到家時，前門是鎖著的。

examples.en: She found the classroom locked and went to ask the teacher.
examples.zh: 她發現教室鎖著，就去問老師。

examples.en: Keep the cabinet locked so the children cannot open it.
examples.zh: 請把櫃子鎖好，免得孩子打開。

examples.en: The old locomotive pulled ten cars up the hill.
examples.zh: 那輛老火車頭拉著十節車廂爬上山坡。

examples.en: We visited a museum with a steam locomotive from 1920.
examples.zh: 我們參觀了一間展有 1920 年蒸汽火車頭的博物館。

examples.en: The locomotive blew its whistle as it left the station.
examples.zh: 火車頭在駛離車站時鳴了汽笛。

examples.en: A swarm of locusts destroyed the farmers' wheat fields.
examples.zh: 一群蝗蟲毀掉了農夫的麥田。

examples.en: The locust is a type of grasshopper that travels in large groups.
examples.zh: 蝗蟲是一種成群遷徙的蚱蜢。

examples.en: Our science book has a picture of a locust on the cover.
examples.zh: 我們的自然課本封面有一張蝗蟲的圖片。

examples.en: He is a longtime fan of the local baseball team.
examples.zh: 他是當地棒球隊的長年球迷。

examples.en: My longtime neighbor moved away last month.
examples.zh: 我多年的鄰居上個月搬走了。

examples.en: She thanked her longtime friends for their support.
examples.zh: 她感謝多年好友的支持。

examples.en: My grandmother still weaves cloth on an old wooden loom.
examples.zh: 我奶奶還在用一台老舊的木製織布機織布。

examples.en: The museum has a loom that is over two hundred years old.
examples.zh: 博物館有一台已有兩百多年歷史的織布機。

examples.en: Students learned how to use a loom in art class.
examples.zh: 學生們在美術課學習如何使用織布機。

examples.en: A tall building loomed through the thick fog.
examples.zh: 一棟高樓在濃霧中隱隱浮現。

examples.en: Exams are looming, so we need to study harder.
examples.zh: 考試即將來臨，所以我們得更用功讀書。

examples.en: Dark clouds loomed over the town before the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨來臨前，烏雲籠罩在小鎮上空。

examples.en: The police found the loot hidden in an old barn.
examples.zh: 警方在一間舊穀倉裡找到了贓物。

examples.en: In the video game, you can collect loot after each level.
examples.zh: 在這款電玩遊戲裡，每過一關就能收集戰利品。

examples.en: The museum displays loot taken from ancient ships.
examples.zh: 博物館展示了從古代船隻取得的戰利品。

examples.en: Thieves looted several stores during the power outage.
examples.zh: 停電期間，竊賊洗劫了好幾家商店。

examples.en: Soldiers looted the old temple centuries ago.
examples.zh: 幾百年前，士兵洗劫了這座古廟。

examples.en: The report says the tomb was looted long before the experts arrived.
examples.zh: 報告指出，這座古墓早在專家抵達前就被盜了。

examples.en: A lost child was crying near the station entrance.
examples.zh: 一個迷路的孩子在車站入口附近哭泣。

examples.en: Please hand in any lost items at the front desk.
examples.zh: 撿到遺失物品請交到櫃檯。

examples.en: She regretted the lost opportunity to study abroad that summer.
examples.zh: 她為那年夏天錯失的留學機會感到後悔。

examples.en: Our team lost the game by only one point.
examples.zh: 我們隊伍以一分之差輸掉了比賽。

examples.en: I lost my wallet on the train yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天把錢包弄丟在火車上。

examples.en: She has lost weight since she started swimming.
examples.zh: 她開始游泳後體重減輕了。

examples.en: Mechanics lubricate the engine parts to keep them running well.
examples.zh: 技師替引擎零件上潤滑油，讓它們運轉順暢。

examples.en: You should lubricate the bicycle chain every few months.
examples.zh: 你應該每隔幾個月替腳踏車鏈條上油。

examples.en: Oil is used to lubricate the hinges of the old door.
examples.zh: 人們用油來潤滑那扇舊門的鉸鏈。

examples.en: The workers carried the lumber into the new house.
examples.zh: 工人們把木材搬進新房子。

examples.en: This store sells lumber for building fences and tables.
examples.zh: 這間店販售用來做圍籬和桌子的木材。

examples.en: The country exports a large amount of lumber every year.
examples.zh: 這個國家每年出口大量木材。

examples.en: The big truck lumbered slowly up the narrow road.
examples.zh: 那輛大卡車笨重地沿著窄路緩緩上坡。

examples.en: A tired bear lumbered across the field.
examples.zh: 一隻疲憊的熊笨重地走過田野。

examples.en: The old bus lumbered into the station ten minutes late.
examples.zh: 那輛老舊的公車慢吞吞地駛進車站，晚了十分鐘。

examples.en: The clock has a luminous dial that can be read in the dark.
examples.zh: 這個時鐘有夜光錶面，在黑暗中也看得清楚。

examples.en: Luminous stars filled the sky above the mountain.
examples.zh: 發亮的星星佈滿山上的夜空。

examples.en: The child stuck luminous stickers on her bedroom ceiling.
examples.zh: 那個孩子把夜光貼紙貼在臥室天花板上。

senses.zh: 行為極不理智的人（貶義）；精神病人（舊式冒犯用語）

examples.en: The reporter was criticized for calling the driver a lunatic.
examples.zh: 那名記者因為稱呼駕駛為「瘋子」而受到批評。

examples.en: The dictionary warns that lunatic is an offensive term for a mentally ill person.
examples.zh: 字典提醒，lunatic 是對精神疾病患者帶有冒犯性的稱呼。

examples.en: My brother called me a lunatic for waking up at four.
examples.zh: 我哥哥說我四點起床簡直是瘋了。

examples.en: That is a lunatic idea, and nobody will agree to it.
examples.zh: 那是個瘋狂的點子，沒有人會同意。

examples.en: The manager rejected the lunatic plan right away.
examples.zh: 經理立刻否決了那個荒唐的計畫。

examples.en: He made a lunatic bet that he could finish in an hour.
examples.zh: 他瘋狂地打賭自己一小時就能完成。

examples.en: The cafeteria gets crowded at lunchtime, so we usually arrive early.
examples.zh: 自助餐廳一到午餐時間就很擁擠，所以我們通常提早抵達。

examples.en: Let's meet at lunchtime and talk about the project.
examples.zh: 我們午休時碰面談談這個專案吧。

examples.en: The office is closed during lunchtime on Fridays.
examples.zh: 辦公室每週五午休時間不開放。

examples.en: The history book explains why mobs were once able to lynch people unfairly.
examples.zh: 歷史課本說明了為什麼暴民過去能不公正地以私刑處死他人。

examples.en: The film shows town leaders trying to stop a mob from lynching a prisoner.
examples.zh: 這部電影呈現鎮上領袖設法阻止暴民以私刑處死囚犯。

examples.en: Teachers explained that laws exist so no one will lynch another person.
examples.zh: 老師說明，制定法律是為了防止人們以私刑處死他人。

examples.en: I can't remember the lyrics of the second verse.
examples.zh: 我想不起第二段的歌詞內容了。

examples.en: She wrote a short lyric about autumn for the school magazine.
examples.zh: 她為校刊寫了一首關於秋天的短詩。

examples.en: He changed one lyric to make the song funnier.
examples.zh: 他改了一句歌詞，讓這首歌更好笑。

examples.en: The poet is famous for her lyric style.
examples.zh: 這位詩人以抒情風格聞名。

examples.en: We studied a lyric poem about the sea in class.
examples.zh: 我們在課堂上讀了一首關於大海的抒情詩。

examples.en: His lyric voice made the whole audience stop and listen.
examples.zh: 他抒情的嗓音讓全場觀眾都停下來聆聽。

examples.en: The story about the ghost was completely made-up.
examples.zh: 那個鬼的故事完全是捏造的。

examples.en: Kids love reading about made-up worlds with dragons.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡讀有龍存在的虛構世界。

examples.en: She arrived at the party fully made-up and ready to dance.
examples.zh: 她化好了妝，準備好跳舞，來到派對現場。

examples.en: The movie tells the story of a famous mafia family.
examples.zh: 這部電影講述一個著名黑手黨家族的故事。

examples.en: The police worked for years to break up the mafia.
examples.zh: 警方花了數年時間瓦解這個犯罪集團。

examples.en: Our teacher said the mafia began in Italy long ago.
examples.zh: 老師說黑手黨很久以前起源於義大利。

senses.zh: 地方法官；地方行政長官

examples.en: The magistrate listened carefully to both sides of the story.
examples.zh: 地方法官仔細聆聽雙方的說法。

examples.en: A local magistrate handled the case in just one day.
examples.zh: 當地一位法官一天就處理完這個案子。

examples.en: The county magistrate announced plans to improve roads in rural villages.
examples.zh: 縣長宣布了改善鄉村道路的計畫。

examples.en: The earthquake had a magnitude of 6.5.
examples.zh: 這場地震的規模是六點五。

examples.en: We did not understand the magnitude of the problem at first.
examples.zh: 我們起初並不了解這個問題的嚴重程度。

examples.en: Scientists measured the star's magnitude to compare its brightness with other stars.
examples.zh: 科學家測量了這顆恆星的星等，以比較它與其他恆星的亮度。

examples.en: The making of this cake takes about two hours.
examples.zh: 製作這個蛋糕大約需要兩個小時。

examples.en: The movie was three years in the making.
examples.zh: 這部電影籌拍了三年。

examples.en: She is a leader in the making.
examples.zh: 她是個正在養成中的領袖。

examples.en: Malaria is spread by mosquitoes in warm countries.
examples.zh: 瘧疾在溫暖的國家由蚊子傳播。

examples.en: Travelers may need medicine to protect themselves from malaria.
examples.zh: 旅客可能需要吃藥來預防瘧疾。

examples.en: Doctors are working on a new vaccine against malaria.
examples.zh: 醫生們正在研發對抗瘧疾的新疫苗。

examples.en: The driver made a quick maneuver to avoid the box on the road.
examples.zh: 駕駛迅速轉向，避開路上的箱子。

examples.en: The company's clever maneuver helped it win the contract.
examples.zh: 這間公司巧妙的策略幫助它贏得了合約。

examples.en: The navy held training maneuvers off the coast to prepare for emergencies.
examples.zh: 海軍在近海舉行訓練演習，以因應緊急狀況。

examples.en: It is hard to maneuver a big truck in a narrow alley.
examples.zh: 在窄巷中操控大卡車很困難。

examples.en: She tried to maneuver her chair closer to the window.
examples.zh: 她設法把椅子巧妙地挪近窗邊。

examples.en: The pilot maneuvered the plane around the dark clouds.
examples.zh: 機師操縱飛機繞過烏雲。

examples.en: The new party published its manifesto before the election.
examples.zh: 新政黨在選舉前發表了政見宣言。

examples.en: The artists wrote a manifesto about their goals for the group.
examples.zh: 藝術家們寫了一份關於團體目標的宣言。

examples.en: Our club's manifesto says we will keep the park clean.
examples.zh: 我們社團的宣言寫著我們會維持公園整潔。

examples.en: The mare walked slowly beside her young foal.
examples.zh: 那匹母馬慢慢走在牠的小馬旁邊。

examples.en: Our neighbor bought a brown mare for the farm.
examples.zh: 我們的鄰居替牧場買了一匹棕色母馬。

examples.en: The mare is gentle, so children can ride her.
examples.zh: 這匹母馬性情溫和，所以小朋友可以騎牠。

examples.en: There has been a marked improvement in your English.
examples.zh: 你的英文有了明顯的進步。

examples.en: Please use the marked path to reach the top of the hill.
examples.zh: 請沿著標示好的小路走到山頂。

examples.en: The marked change in the weather surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 天氣的明顯變化讓大家都很驚訝。

examples.en: The teacher marked our tests and returned them on Monday.
examples.zh: 老師批改我們的考卷，星期一就發還了。

examples.en: She marked the date on the calendar with a red pen.
examples.zh: 她用紅筆在日曆上標出日期。

examples.en: The festival marked the end of the long winter.
examples.zh: 這個節慶標誌著漫長冬天的結束。

examples.en: She works in marketing for a large clothing company.
examples.zh: 她在一間大型服飾公司擔任行銷工作。

examples.en: Good marketing can help a small shop attract more customers.
examples.zh: 好的行銷能幫小店吸引更多顧客。

examples.en: The marketing team is planning a new online campaign.
examples.zh: 行銷團隊正在規劃一個新的線上活動。

senses.zh: 沼澤（以草本植物為主的濕地）

examples.en: Many birds live in the marsh near our town.
examples.zh: 我們鎮附近的濕地有很多鳥類棲息。

examples.en: We walked along a wooden path across the marsh.
examples.zh: 我們沿著一條木棧道穿越沼澤。

examples.en: The marsh became dry during the long summer.
examples.zh: 漫長的夏天讓這片沼澤乾涸了。

senses.zh: 元帥；執法官；活動秩序指揮人員

examples.en: The marshal led the parade through the center of town.
examples.zh: 遊行指揮人員帶領隊伍穿過市中心。

examples.en: A fire marshal checked the building before the concert.
examples.zh: 一位消防安全官員在音樂會前檢查了這棟建築。

examples.en: The old marshal received a medal for his service.
examples.zh: 那位老元帥因其貢獻獲頒一枚勳章。

examples.en: The teacher marshaled the students into two neat lines.
examples.zh: 老師把學生整頓成兩排整齊的隊伍。

examples.en: She marshaled her ideas before the big speech.
examples.zh: 她在重要演講前整理好自己的想法。

examples.en: The manager marshaled the whole team to finish the report.
examples.zh: 經理召集整個團隊一起完成報告。

examples.en: First, mash the potatoes with a fork.
examples.zh: 首先，用叉子把馬鈴薯壓成泥。

examples.en: Mom likes to mash bananas for the baby.
examples.zh: 媽媽喜歡把香蕉壓成泥給寶寶吃。

examples.en: You can mash the beans and spread them on bread.
examples.zh: 你可以把豆子搗碎後塗在麵包上。

senses.zh: 馬鈴薯泥（英式）；搗碎的食物或混合物

examples.en: We had chicken with mash for dinner.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐吃了雞肉配馬鈴薯泥。

examples.en: The cook added butter to the mash.
examples.zh: 廚師在馬鈴薯泥裡加了奶油。

examples.en: The farmer mixed crushed grain with water to make mash for the chickens.
examples.zh: 農夫把碎穀物和水混合，製成餵雞的糊狀飼料。

examples.en: The museum teaches students about the massacre in history class.
examples.zh: 博物館在歷史課上向學生介紹那場大屠殺。

examples.en: The monument was built to honor the victims of the massacre.
examples.zh: 這座紀念碑是為了紀念大屠殺受難者而建造的。

examples.en: Our team suffered a massacre in the final game, losing by thirty points.
examples.zh: 我們隊在決賽中慘敗，輸了三十分。

senses.zh: 大規模屠殺；徹底擊敗（非正式）

examples.en: History books describe how soldiers massacred the villagers long ago.
examples.zh: 歷史書描述了很久以前士兵屠殺村民的經過。

examples.en: The school team massacred its rivals in the final basketball game.
examples.zh: 校隊在籃球決賽中徹底擊敗了對手。

examples.en: Many nations have promised never to massacre civilians again.
examples.zh: 許多國家承諾不再屠殺平民。

examples.en: Some people worry that materialism is hurting young people.
examples.zh: 有些人擔心物質主義正在傷害年輕人。

examples.en: The writer criticizes the materialism of modern society.
examples.zh: 這位作家批評現代社會的物質主義。

examples.en: Our philosophy teacher explained the difference between materialism and idealism.
examples.zh: 我們的哲學老師解釋了唯物論與唯心論的差異。

examples.en: I like a little mayonnaise on my sandwich.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在三明治上加一點美乃滋。

examples.en: Mix the tuna with some mayonnaise and chopped onions.
examples.zh: 把鮪魚和一些美乃滋及洋蔥丁拌在一起。

examples.en: The mayonnaise in the fridge has expired.
examples.zh: 冰箱裡的美乃滋過期了。

examples.en: The tailor took my measurements before making the suit.
examples.zh: 裁縫師製作西裝前，先替我量了身體尺寸。

examples.en: Careful measurement is important in every science experiment.
examples.zh: 仔細測量對每個科學實驗都很重要。

examples.en: Please write down the window's measurements in centimeters before ordering new curtains.
examples.zh: 訂購新窗簾前，請以公分記下窗戶的尺寸。

senses.zh: 力學；機械原理；運作機制

examples.en: My brother is studying mechanics at a technical college.
examples.zh: 我哥哥在技術學院念機械學。

examples.en: The mechanics of the game are easy to learn.
examples.zh: 這個遊戲的運作機制很容易學會。

examples.en: The class covered the basic mechanics of how a bicycle works.
examples.zh: 這堂課講解了腳踏車運作的基本原理。

examples.en: The tea has a mellow taste that I really enjoy.
examples.zh: 這款茶的味道醇厚柔和，我很喜歡。

examples.en: Soft, mellow music played in the cafe.
examples.zh: 咖啡廳裡播放著輕柔舒緩的音樂。

examples.en: My grandfather has become more mellow as he has gotten older.
examples.zh: 我爺爺隨著年紀增長，變得更隨和了。

examples.en: His anger began to mellow after a good night's sleep.
examples.zh: 睡了一個好覺後，他的怒氣開始消退。

examples.en: Wine can mellow if you keep it for many years.
examples.zh: 葡萄酒若存放多年，口感會變得圓潤。

examples.en: She hopes her brother will mellow as he grows up.
examples.zh: 她希望弟弟長大後脾氣能變得溫和一些。

senses.zh: 威脅；惹麻煩的人或動物

examples.en: Speeding drivers are a menace to everyone on the road.
examples.zh: 超速的駕駛是路上所有人的威脅。

examples.en: The little dog is a menace when it chews the furniture.
examples.zh: 那隻小狗啃咬家具時簡直是個搗蛋鬼。

examples.en: Pollution is a growing menace to our oceans.
examples.zh: 汙染對我們的海洋是日益嚴重的威脅。

examples.en: Dark clouds menaced the coast all afternoon.
examples.zh: 烏雲整個下午都威脅著海岸地區。

examples.en: The new rules menace the survival of small farms.
examples.zh: 新規定威脅到小型農場的生存。

examples.en: A large storm menaced the town last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚一場大風暴威脅著小鎮。

examples.en: Old thermometers used mercury to measure temperature.
examples.zh: 舊式溫度計用水銀來測量溫度。

examples.en: Mercury is the closest planet to the sun.
examples.zh: 水星是離太陽最近的行星。

examples.en: Some fish contain mercury, which is harmful to people.
examples.zh: 有些魚含有汞，對人體有害。

examples.en: The two banks announced a merger last week.
examples.zh: 這兩家銀行上週宣布合併。

examples.en: The merger will create one of the largest companies in the country.
examples.zh: 這項合併將成立全國最大的公司之一。

examples.en: Many employees were worried about the merger.
examples.zh: 許多員工對這次合併感到擔憂。

examples.en: The old pipe made a metallic sound when I hit it.
examples.zh: 我敲那根舊水管時，它發出金屬般的聲響。

examples.en: She bought a car with a metallic blue finish.
examples.zh: 她買了一輛金屬藍烤漆的車。

examples.en: Metallic elements such as iron conduct heat and electricity well.
examples.zh: 鐵等金屬元素能良好地傳導熱與電。

examples.en: Most countries use the metric system to measure length.
examples.zh: 大多數國家使用公制來測量長度。

examples.en: A meter is a basic metric unit of length.
examples.zh: 公尺是長度的基本公制單位。

examples.en: We converted the recipe to metric measurements.
examples.zh: 我們把食譜換算成公制單位。

examples.en: Sales are the main metric for judging this store's success.
examples.zh: 銷售額是評斷這家店成功與否的主要指標。

examples.en: The company uses several metrics to track customer happiness.
examples.zh: 這間公司用好幾項指標來追蹤顧客的滿意度。

examples.en: Test scores are only one metric of a student's progress.
examples.zh: 考試成績只是衡量學生進步的其中一項指標。

examples.en: Many birds migrate south for the winter.
examples.zh: 許多鳥類會向南遷徙過冬。

examples.en: Some families migrate to the city to find better jobs.
examples.zh: 有些家庭為了找更好的工作而移居到城市。

examples.en: Whales migrate thousands of kilometers every year.
examples.zh: 鯨魚每年遷徙數千公里。

senses.zh: 里程數；燃油效率；里程補助

examples.en: The car has low mileage and is in good condition.
examples.zh: 這輛車的里程數很低，狀況良好。

examples.en: This model gets excellent gas mileage on the highway.
examples.zh: 這個車款在高速公路上的油耗表現很優秀。

examples.en: You can claim the mileage when you travel for work.
examples.zh: 因公出差時你可以申請里程補助。

examples.en: The union took a more militant position in the talks.
examples.zh: 工會在談判中採取更強硬的立場。

examples.en: Some militant groups refused to join the peace talks.
examples.zh: 有些激進團體拒絕參加和談。

examples.en: The newspaper described his militant speech as too angry.
examples.zh: 報紙認為他那篇激進的演說太過憤怒。

examples.en: The report says the militant had left the country.
examples.zh: 報告指出那名激進分子已離開該國。

examples.en: Several militants were arrested by the local police.
examples.zh: 數名激進分子被當地警方逮捕。

examples.en: The leader said he was not a militant but a peaceful organizer.
examples.zh: 這位領導人說他不是激進分子，而是和平的組織者。

examples.en: The town formed a militia to protect its farms.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮組成民兵團來保護農場。

examples.en: The history book explains how the militia fought for the colony.
examples.zh: 歷史課本說明民兵如何為殖民地而戰。

examples.en: Members of the militia trained every weekend in the field.
examples.zh: 民兵成員每個週末都在野外訓練。

examples.en: The miller ground the wheat into fine flour.
examples.zh: 磨坊主人把小麥磨成細麵粉。

examples.en: My great-grandfather worked as a miller in a small village.
examples.zh: 我曾祖父在一個小村莊當磨坊工人。

examples.en: The miller sold sacks of flour to the local bakery.
examples.zh: 磨坊主人把一袋袋麵粉賣給當地的麵包店。

examples.en: The screw is only three millimeters wide.
examples.zh: 這根螺絲只有三公釐寬。

examples.en: It rained so little that the gauge showed just one millimeter.
examples.zh: 雨下得很少，雨量計只顯示一公釐。

examples.en: Please measure the paper's width to the nearest millimeter.
examples.zh: 請測量紙張寬度，並四捨五入至整數公釐。

examples.en: Mining was the main industry in the town for over a century.
examples.zh: 採礦曾是這個小鎮的主要產業，時間長達一百多年。

examples.en: Coal mining has declined in many countries in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年來許多國家的煤礦開採已經減少。

examples.en: Her grandfather worked in gold mining before he retired.
examples.zh: 她的祖父退休前從事金礦開採工作。

examples.en: The two countries will hold a ministerial meeting next week.
examples.zh: 兩國將在下週舉行部長級會議。

examples.en: He accepted a ministerial post in the new government.
examples.zh: 他接受了新政府的部長職位。

examples.en: The ministerial decision was announced at a press conference.
examples.zh: 部長的決定在記者會上宣布了。

examples.en: She suffered a miscarriage early in her pregnancy.
examples.zh: 她在懷孕初期流產了。

examples.en: The lawyer called the verdict a miscarriage of justice.
examples.zh: 律師稱這項判決是司法的誤判。

examples.en: The doctor explained that a miscarriage is not always preventable.
examples.zh: 醫師說明，自然流產不一定能夠預防。

examples.en: The old miser never spent a penny on gifts.
examples.zh: 那位老守財奴從不花一毛錢買禮物。

examples.en: Don't be such a miser and share your snacks with us.
examples.zh: 別這麼小氣，把你的點心分給我們吧。

examples.en: In the story, the miser hid his gold under the floor.
examples.zh: 故事中，那個守財奴把金子藏在地板下。

examples.en: You are mistaken if you think the test will be easy.
examples.zh: 如果你以為考試會很簡單，那就錯了。

examples.en: The police arrested him because of mistaken identity.
examples.zh: 警方因為認錯人而逮捕了他。

examples.en: She had a mistaken belief that the store was open on Sundays.
examples.zh: 她誤以為這家店星期天有營業。

examples.en: There was green mold on the old bread in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 廚房裡那片舊麵包上長了綠色的黴。

examples.en: The baker poured the batter into a heart-shaped mold.
examples.zh: 烘焙師把麵糊倒進心形的模具裡。

examples.en: Damp walls can lead to mold and health problems.
examples.zh: 潮濕的牆壁可能造成發霉和健康問題。

examples.en: The potter molded the wet clay into a small bowl.
examples.zh: 陶藝家把濕黏土塑成一個小碗。

examples.en: Good teachers help mold the character of their students.
examples.zh: 好老師能幫助塑造學生的品格。

examples.en: Mold the dough into small balls before baking.
examples.zh: 烘烤前先把麵糰揉成小球。

examples.en: Britain is a monarchy with a king at its head.
examples.zh: 英國是由國王領導的君主制國家。

examples.en: The country voted to end the monarchy in 1946.
examples.zh: 該國在1946年投票廢除君主制。

examples.en: A constitutional monarchy limits the power of the king or queen.
examples.zh: 君主立憲制限制了國王或女王的權力。

examples.en: The teacher's monotonous voice made me sleepy in class.
examples.zh: 老師單調的聲音讓我在課堂上昏昏欲睡。

examples.en: Working on the assembly line can be monotonous.
examples.zh: 在生產線上工作可能很乏味。

examples.en: We drove for hours along the monotonous highway.
examples.zh: 我們沿著單調的公路開了好幾個小時。

senses.zh: 荒原（多為長有草與矮灌木的開闊高地）

examples.en: We walked across the open moor on a foggy morning.
examples.zh: 我們在一個起霧的早晨走過空曠的荒野。

examples.en: Sheep wandered freely over the wild moor.
examples.zh: 綿羊在遼闊的荒野上自由漫步。

examples.en: The novel is set on a lonely moor in northern England.
examples.zh: 這部小說的場景是英格蘭北部一片孤寂的荒野。

examples.en: The sailors moored the boat to a post at the dock.
examples.zh: 水手們把船繫在碼頭的柱子上。

examples.en: We moored the yacht in the bay for the night.
examples.zh: 我們把遊艇停泊在海灣過夜。

examples.en: The ferry is moored near the old fish market.
examples.zh: 渡輪停靠在舊魚市場附近。

examples.en: The workers mixed sand and cement to make mortar.
examples.zh: 工人們把沙子和水泥拌在一起做成砂漿。

examples.en: Use a mortar and pestle to crush the garlic.
examples.zh: 用研缽和杵把大蒜搗碎。

examples.en: The museum displayed an old mortar used during the war.
examples.zh: 那面老石牆的磚塊之間，砂漿正在剝落。

examples.en: Many people gather at the mosque on Friday afternoons.
examples.zh: 許多人在星期五下午聚集到清真寺。

examples.en: The tourists took photos outside the famous blue mosque.
examples.zh: 遊客們在著名的藍色清真寺外拍照。

examples.en: Visitors must take off their shoes before entering the mosque.
examples.zh: 訪客進入清真寺前必須脫鞋。

examples.en: Green moss covered the rocks beside the stream.
examples.zh: 綠色的苔蘚覆蓋了溪邊的岩石。

examples.en: Moss grows best in damp and shady places.
examples.zh: 苔蘚在潮濕又陰暗的地方長得最好。

examples.en: The old roof was soft with moss after years of rain.
examples.zh: 經過多年雨水，老屋頂長滿了柔軟的苔蘚。

examples.en: Motorists are advised to avoid the bridge during the storm.
examples.zh: 建議駕駛人在暴風雨期間避開這座橋。

examples.en: A kind motorist stopped to help us change the tire.
examples.zh: 一位好心的駕駛人停下來幫我們換輪胎。

examples.en: Fuel prices are a big concern for many motorists.
examples.zh: 油價是許多駕駛人很關心的事。

examples.en: We took the motorway to get to the airport faster.
examples.zh: 我們走高速公路，這樣比較快到機場。

examples.en: There was a long traffic jam on the motorway this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上高速公路上大塞車。

examples.en: The new motorway connects the capital to the coast.
examples.zh: 這條新的高速公路把首都和海岸連接起來。

senses.zh: 騎馬的；固定裝設的；裱好的

examples.en: Mounted police rode through the park on Sunday.
examples.zh: 騎警星期天騎馬穿過了公園。

examples.en: A mounted camera at the door records everyone who enters.
examples.zh: 門口裝設的攝影機會記錄所有進入的人。

examples.en: The mounted photo on the wall was a gift from my uncle.
examples.zh: 牆上裱好的照片是叔叔送的禮物。

senses.zh: 吹嘴；（電話的）送話器；喉舌（常含貶義）

examples.en: The player cleaned the mouthpiece of his trumpet after the show.
examples.zh: 演出結束後，樂手清潔了他小號的吹嘴。

examples.en: Please speak clearly into the mouthpiece of the phone.
examples.zh: 請對著電話的話筒清楚地說話。

examples.en: The newspaper is seen as a mouthpiece for the government.
examples.zh: 這份報紙被視為政府的喉舌。

examples.en: The movie had such a moving ending that many people cried.
examples.zh: 這部電影的結局十分感人，許多人都哭了。

examples.en: Never try to get off a moving bus.
examples.zh: 切勿嘗試從行進中的公車下車。

examples.en: Her speech about her grandmother was deeply moving.
examples.zh: 她談論祖母的演說非常動人。

examples.en: My dad pushed the mower across the front lawn.
examples.zh: 我爸爸推著割草機走過前院草坪。

examples.en: The mower ran out of gas halfway through the yard.
examples.zh: 割草機割到院子一半就沒油了。

examples.en: We bought a new electric mower last weekend.
examples.zh: 我們上週末買了一台新的電動割草機。

examples.en: She works for a multinational company with offices in ten countries.
examples.zh: 她在一家在十個國家設有辦事處的跨國公司工作。

examples.en: A multinational team of scientists made the discovery.
examples.zh: 一個多國科學家組成的團隊做出了這項發現。

examples.en: The multinational force helped keep peace in the region.
examples.zh: 多國部隊協助維持該地區的和平。

examples.en: The small shop was bought by a multinational last year.
examples.zh: 這家小店去年被一家跨國公司買下。

examples.en: Many multinationals are moving factories to Southeast Asia.
examples.zh: 許多跨國公司正把工廠遷往東南亞。

examples.en: The multinational announced plans to hire more local workers.
examples.zh: 那家跨國公司宣布計畫僱用更多當地員工。

examples.en: A multitude of stars filled the sky above the mountain.
examples.zh: 山上的夜空佈滿了無數的星星。

examples.en: The singer greeted the multitude waiting outside the stadium.
examples.zh: 歌手向在體育場外等候的群眾致意。

examples.en: There are a multitude of reasons to learn a second language.
examples.zh: 學習第二語言有許多理由。

examples.en: He muttered something under his breath and left the room.
examples.zh: 他小聲嘀咕了幾句就離開了房間。

examples.en: Stop muttering and tell us what you really think.
examples.zh: 別再嘀咕了，告訴我們你真正的想法。

examples.en: The old man muttered to himself as he walked home.
examples.zh: 老先生一邊走路回家，一邊喃喃自語。

examples.en: We heard a low mutter from the back of the classroom.
examples.zh: 我們聽到教室後方傳來低低的嘀咕聲。

examples.en: She answered with a mutter and kept reading.
examples.zh: 她含糊地嘀咕了一聲，繼續看書。

examples.en: The mutter of the crowd grew louder as the rain began.
examples.zh: 雨開始下時，群眾的嘀咕聲越來越大。

examples.en: We ordered mutton soup at the restaurant.
examples.zh: 我們在餐廳點了羊肉湯。

examples.en: Mutton has a stronger flavor than lamb.
examples.zh: 成年綿羊肉的味道比羔羊肉更濃。

examples.en: My grandmother cooked mutton with ginger and rice wine.
examples.zh: 我奶奶用薑和米酒煮羊肉。

examples.en: We studied Greek mythology in our literature class.
